name: Texture Map Coding (TMC)
aliases: SLF Coefficient Compression via Texture Map Coding
definition: A lossy compression method for Surface Light Field (SLF) coefficients where 3D surface points are mapped to 2D images, allowing the use of standard image codecs. It is used to compress SLF coefficients independently.
summary: Texture Map Coding is a lossy compression method for Surface Light Field coefficients that maps 3D points to 2D texture coordinates, leveraging standard image codecs for higher rate-distortion performance than hierarchical methods.
